messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide to help you get your acoustic guitar sold quickly and at a fair price: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1. Clean & Tune** | Give the guitar a quick wash (soft cloth, mild cleaner) and tune it to standard tuning (E‑A‑D‑G‑B‑E). | A well‑presented, properly tuned instrument looks more appealing and shows you’ve cared for it. | | **2. Take Quality Photos** | • Use natural light (outside or near a window).
• Capture front, back, side, headstock, strings, and any visible wear.
• Include a reference object (e.g., a coin or a ruler) for scale. | Good photos attract buyers and reduce questions about condition. | | **3. Write a Clear Description** | • Brand, model, year, wood type, finish, and any special features.
• Mention any repairs, upgrades, or modifications.
• Be honest about scratches, dents, or other imperfections. | Transparency builds trust and reduces returns or disputes. | | **4. Research Pricing** | • Check completed listings on eBay, Reverb, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, and local classifieds.
• Compare similar models in similar condition. | Helps set a realistic asking price and speeds up the sale. | | **5. Choose Your Selling Platform(s)** | • **Online Marketplaces** – eBay, Reverb, Etsy (for vintage), Amazon (if you’re a seller).
• **Local Classifieds** – Craigslist, Gumtree, Kijiji.
• **Social Media** – Facebook Marketplace, Instagram (use reels or stories).
• **Consignment Shops** – Local music stores or specialty consignment shops. | Multiple platforms increase exposure; choose what fits your timeline and risk tolerance. | | **6. Set Shipping Options (if selling online)** | • Offer free shipping if you can afford it; otherwise, calculate cost and add to price.
• Use sturdy packaging: hard case or padded envelope, bubble wrap, and a cardboard box.
• Insure the shipment for its full value. | Proper packaging protects the guitar and gives buyers confidence. | | **7. Negotiate Safely** | • Keep all communication within the platform’s messaging system.
• For local sales, meet in a public place (coffee shop, police station parking lot).
• Accept secure payment methods (PayPal, Venmo, cash). | Reduces fraud risk and ensures you have proof of transaction. | | **8. Finalize the Sale** | • Sign a simple bill of sale (include buyer’s name, date, price, and a statement “as-is”).
• Transfer ownership paperwork if required (some states require a signed release). | Provides legal protection for both parties. | | **9. Follow Up** | • Ask the buyer for feedback (especially on eBay/Reverb).
• Leave a review for the buyer if the platform allows. | Builds reputation and encourages future buyers. | ### Quick Tips - **Timing:** Listings posted mid‑week (Tuesday‑Thursday) often get more views than weekend posts. - **Price Flexibility:** If you’re in a hurry, consider pricing slightly above your target and be ready to negotiate. - **Safety First:** Never let strangers bring money to your home; always meet in a safe, public location. ### Example Listing (Reverb) ``` Title: 2010 Yamaha FG800 Acoustic Guitar – Excellent Condition Description: - Brand/Model: Yamaha FG800 - Year: 2010 - Wood: Spruce top, Mahogany back & sides - Finish: Natural - Features: Built-in pickup, 12‑string option available - Condition: Minor scratch on back, no cracks, fully functional electronics - Extras: Original case, extra strings, cleaning kit Price: $350 (Negotiable) Photos: [Attach 6 high‑resolution images] Shipping: Free shipping within the U.S. (insured, tracked) ``` Feel free to adapt this template to your own guitar’s specifics. Good luck with your sale!
